title: Broken checkout in new API deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the api component, the AttributeError bug from the deploy, and the trigger as the deployment of api 2.3.2.
root_cause: The deployment of api version 2.3.2 introduced a bug where a None value is passed to .strip() during order validation, causing an AttributeError on every order request.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a regression in the order creation logic: a missing null check on the payment_token field causes an unhandled AttributeError on POST /api/orders, while read endpoints like /api/products still work.
check_first: inspect the api container's logs and health check endpoint
